Ambassador Room

Enjoy ultimate comfort in the Ambassador Suite, designed for those seeking spaciousness and sophistication. Floor-to-ceiling windows flood the room with natural light and offer breathtaking city views, while a private Jacuzzi invites you to relax in complete comfort. A luxurious queen bed takes center stage, complemented by an elegant sitting area and a high table perfect for admiring the skyline. The private marble bathroom features a spacious rain shower that will provide a refined, spa-like experience.

Amenities

Everything you need

In addition, our guests can enjoy a variety of extra services, including buffet breakfast, 24-hour reception, 24-hour security, room service with a full menu available at all times, a cozy coffee shop, exclusive access to our heated pool and rooftop bar, where you can enjoy a stunning 360° panoramic view of the captivating city of Medellín.
